title_zh: 运行之后，可能已经改了东西
outcome_en: You can distinguish harmless-looking checks from commands that may create, change, install, or delete things.
outcome_zh: 你能初步分清哪些命令像是在检查，哪些命令可能创建、修改、安装或删除东西。

blocks.body_en: Running code is the moment risk can enter. Not every command is dangerous, and you do not need a full security course yet. But you do need one early habit: ask whether this command only checks something, or may change something.
blocks.body_zh: 运行代码，是风险可能进入的那一刻。不是每条命令都危险，你现在也不需要上一整门安全课。但你需要很早养成一个习惯：这条命令只是检查什么，还是可能改动什么？

blocks.term_zh: 副作用 / 额外影响（side effect）
blocks.anchor_en: Reading a recipe has no side effect; cooking it uses ingredients, makes dishes dirty, and changes the kitchen.
blocks.anchor_zh: 读菜谱没有副作用；真的做菜会用掉食材、弄脏盘子、改变厨房状态。
blocks.explain_en: A side effect is a change a program makes outside its own calculation: creating a file, editing data, deleting something, installing a package, sending a request. When an agent runs code, ask what side effects are possible.
blocks.explain_zh: 副作用指程序在自己计算之外造成的改变：创建文件、修改数据、删除东西、安装包、向外发送请求。agent 运行代码时，你要问：它可能带来哪些额外影响？

blocks.body_en: At this stage, you are not memorizing a list of safe and unsafe commands. You are learning a judgment pattern. Words like `write`, `delete`, `install`, `upload`, and `send` should make you slow down.
blocks.body_zh: 这个阶段不是让你背「哪些命令安全、哪些命令危险」的清单，而是先学一个判断模式。看到 write（写入）、delete（删除）、install（安装）、upload（上传）、send（发送）这类词，你就应该慢一点。

blocks.body_en: Checkpoint: after this lesson, you can ask a practical safety question before approving an agent run: if this command succeeds halfway and then crashes, what may already have changed?
blocks.body_zh: 这一课的小结：现在你在同意 agent 运行之前，可以先问一个实际的安全问题：如果这条命令跑到一半又崩了，什么东西可能已经被改过？

exercises.prompt_en: Which action is most clearly a side effect?
exercises.prompt_zh: 下面哪个动作最明显属于副作用 / 额外影响？
options_en: Reading a line of source code
exercises.explain_en: Creating a file changes the outside world of the program. That is a side effect.
exercises.explain_zh: 创建文件会改变程序外部的世界，所以它是副作用。

exercises.prompt_en: The term for an external change caused by running code is ______ effect.
exercises.prompt_zh: 运行代码造成的外部改变，英文叫 ______ effect。
exercises.explain_en: A side effect is any meaningful change beyond returning a result.
exercises.explain_zh: side effect（副作用 / 额外影响）指程序除了返回结果之外，还对外部造成了改变。

exercises.prompt_en: An agent says: "The script crashed after writing 200 rows." What should you infer?
exercises.prompt_zh: agent 说："The script crashed after writing 200 rows."（脚本写入 200 行之后崩溃了。）你应该怎么理解？
options_en: Even though it crashed, it may already have changed data
Because it crashed, nothing could have changed
It was only source code and never ran
This proves the current directory was wrong
options_zh: 虽然它崩了，但数据可能已经被改过
因为它崩了，所以一定什么都没改
它只是源代码，从来没有运行
这证明当前目录一定错了
exercises.explain_en: Interpreted or running programs can do partial work before failing. A crash does not undo every side effect.
exercises.explain_zh: 正在运行的程序可能先做了一部分事，然后才失败。崩溃不代表之前的副作用都会自动撤销。
